assumptions.claim: When status is Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon, winningEntry >= 1 (in [1, totalEntries]), so an unminted ticketId whose _ticketRanges entry is (0, 0) fails selectedEntry > lastEntry in _requireWinningTicket.

Minted ticket ranges in _ticketRanges[1..ticketCount] partition [1, totalEntries] into contiguous, non-overlapping inclusive intervals [firstEntry, lastEntry] with 1 <= firstEntry <= lastEntry <= totalEntries, and unminted ticket IDs have (0, 0).

Prior to the first _settleWinningTicket execution in Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon, unsettledPot == uint256(totalEntries) * ENTRY_PRICE >= 1_000_000, so on the Status.CashWon branch winnerProceeds == floor(grossPot * 8000 / 10_000) >= 800_000 > 0 (required by Raffle.redeemWinningTicket at L340).
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.buyEntries (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L218, L223, L233), Raffle.requestDraw (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L243, L252), Raffle.enableRefunds (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L279-L299), and Raffle._settleWinningTicket (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L534, L551)

assumptions.claim: Prior to _settleWinningTicket execution, winnerProceeds == 0, sponsorProceeds == 0, protocolFees == 0, and remainingRefundLiability == 0, so overwriting these fields (and leaving winnerProceeds untouched on Status.NftWon) preserves accountedQuoteBalance().
The Raffle clone holds at least unsettledPot raw units of quoteToken to back the allocated winnerProceeds, sponsorProceeds, and protocolFees claims.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.buyEntries (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L223-L224, L233) and RaffleFactory.constructor / Raffle.constructor quoteToken configuration (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L66-L85, packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L155-L162)

assumptions.claim: RaffleConstants.PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS + RaffleConstants.CASH_WINNER_BPS <= RaffleConstants.BPS and RaffleConstants.BPS > 0, preventing division by zero in Math.mulDiv and arithmetic underflow in grossPot - protocolFee and grossPot - protocolFee - cashAmount.

calls.propagates: Reverts with TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry unless _ticketRanges[ticketId].firstEntry <= winningEntry <= _ticketRanges[ticketId].lastEntry (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L579-L585); relies on caller/state invariant winningEntry >= 1 to reject unminted (0, 0) ranges.
Returns stored (_ticketRanges[ticketId].firstEntry, _ticketRanges[ticketId].lastEntry) without validation, returning (0, 0) for unminted ticket IDs (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L451-L455).

Computes exact floor(grossPot * bps / 10_000) via 512-bit intermediate multiplication (Math.mul512), reverting only if denominator == 0 or result >= 2^256 (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol:L37-L46, L143-L150, L206-L277; Panic.sol:L50-L56; SafeCast.sol:L1157-L1161). Guarantees protocolFee <= grossPot * 500 / 10_000 and cashAmount <= grossPot * 8000 / 10_000.

invariants.claim: _settleWinningTicket can succeed at most once per Raffle clone and only when status is Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon.
Upon completion, winningTicketId is set to a ticketId whose stored range satisfies _ticketRanges[ticketId].firstEntry <= winningEntry <= _ticketRanges[ticketId].lastEntry.

Upon completion, unsettledPot is 0 and the pre-call unsettledPot (grossPot) is partitioned without loss across protocolFees + sponsorProceeds + winnerProceeds == grossPot (with winnerProceeds == 0 on Status.NftWon and winnerProceeds == floor(grossPot * 8000 / 10_000) on Status.CashWon).
_settleWinningTicket performs no external calls and does not read or mutate ERC-721 ticket ownership.
